blurb: High Roller Fun Rentals offers a variety of rental options including specialty bikes, surrey bikes, paddle boats, character paddle boats, canoes, kayaks, and electric bikes. Guests can enjoy peaceful paddles down the river, family bike rides through the park, or group outings. Located in Frame Park along the Fox River in Waukesha, it is suitable for all ages including young children and first-time riders.
